name: Computer Science

credential.title: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's

summary: A two-and-a-half-year academy profession (AP) degree in programming and system development, with an internship in the fifth semester. It is taught in Esbjerg and is shorter than a bachelor's. Needs Maths B and English B.
description: The five-semester course combines programming, system development, technology and organisational theory. It includes electives, a company internship and a final project.

structure.teachingStyle: Theory and practical work in programming and system development.
structure.placement: An internship in semester five, in Denmark or abroad.
structure.studyAbroad: A semester abroad or an internship abroad is possible.
